title: Signaling Virtue: Charitable Behavior Under Consumer Elective Pricing
authors: Minah H. Jung; Leif D. Nelson; Uri Gneezy B; Ayelet Gneezy
eligible_reason: Two field experiments randomizing charity percentage under consumer elective pricing (plus Studies A, B); between-condition comparisons. The 'law' variable in S1 is a 2012 vs 2013 wave indicator, not a staggered treatment. No DiD.
design_notes: datafile/ ships S1.csv, S2.csv, SA.csv, SB.csv and a variable description; no analysis code.
